description: Read every new issue from the allowed publications into the brain, whole, so they can answer questions later. Returns what landed: `created` is new issues, `updated` is ones whose text changed, `unchanged` is ones already held, which is the normal case for a second run in a day. With no allowed sender it reads nothing and says so, which means the owner has not chosen yet — call find_my_newsletters and ask. `issues` names what arrived, newest first, so the summary can be written from it without another call.

days.description: How far back to read. Default 2.

name: read_my_newsletters
title: Read my newsletters
